description: This file defines the LicenseService class responsible for managing license data, including CRUD operations and license existence checks within the OrangeHRM system. It interacts with the LicenseDao class for database access and makes use of data transfer objects like License and LicenseSearchFilterParams.

classes.name: LicenseService
classes.description: Service class providing license management functionalities such as saving, retrieving, deleting, and verifying licenses.

methods.name: saveLicense
methods.description: Saves a license object, either creating a new record or updating an existing one.

methods.name: getLicenseById
methods.description: Retrieves a license by its unique ID.

methods.name: getLicenseByName
methods.description: Retrieves a license by its name, case-insensitive.

methods.name: getLicenseList
methods.description: Fetches a list of licenses based on search filter parameters.

methods.name: getLicenseCount
methods.description: Counts the number of licenses matching specific search criteria.

methods.name: deleteLicenses
methods.description: Deletes multiple licenses based on an array of IDs.

methods.name: isExistingLicenseName
methods.description: Checks if a license name already exists in the database, case-insensitive.
